title: PFD
text: Phase/frequency detector that compares phase and frequency between two signals, 2 inputs, 2 outputs; {Deadband compensation (s)} sets the delay added for active output near zero phase offset, {Enable increased buffer size}, {Buffer size} sets the number of samples of the input buffering available during, {Enable impairments} adds circuit impairments to simulation, {Output step size calculation} determines how output step size is calculated, {Maximum frequency of interest (Hz)} sets the maximum frequency of interest at output, {Rise/fall time (s)} sets the 20% – 80% rise/fall time for up output port of PFD and {Propagation Delay (s)} sets the delay from input port to output port of PFD. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Deadband compensation (s)
params.values: Delay added for active output near zero phase offset 30e-12 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Enable increased buffer size
params.values: Enable increased buffer size off (default) | on

params.name: Buffer size
params.values: Number of samples of the input buffering available during simulation 10 (default) | positive integer scalar

params.name: Enable impairments
params.values: Add circuit impairments to simulation on (default) | off

params.name: Output step size calculation
params.values: Determine how output step size is calculated Default (default) | Advanced

params.name: Maximum frequency of interest (Hz)
params.values: Maximum frequency of interest at output 10e9 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Rise/fall time (s)
params.values: 20% – 80% rise/fall time for up output port of PFD 3e-11 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Propagation Delay (s)
params.values: Delay from input port to output port of PFD 50e-12 (default) | positive real scalar
